# Pendexter

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Pendexter is a heavenly gorgeous, lofty, and majestic woman with an extraordinarily dressed appearance. She features a lovely, refined visage with beautiful, big, dark-lashed violet eyes and beautiful lips.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Pendexter visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Robin's home for dinner alongside [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) and Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md). During the visit, the group also went for a stroll together.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_
